note: LANGUAGE EVOLUTION contract: the sequence by which LANGUAGE N+1 becomes authoritative, each step bound to the mechanism that realizes it and its status today (RUN = the mechanism exists and ran in D27 or an earlier delta on this host; GAP = to be built in FC-5/FC-6; UNK = the RUST_BUILD boundary).  Bound into law by the D27 annotations of ASCII-GRAMMAR.md (station S-LANGUAGE-LAW) and STATION-REGISTRY.md.

laws.law: COMPILER N DEFINES LANGUAGE N: the machine-readable language manifest is derived from the compiler source, never authored beside it; a grammar text that disagrees with the manifest is refused
NEW SYNTAX MAY NOT AUTHORIZE ITSELF: a proposal for LANGUAGE N+1 is assembled in LANGUAGE N plus non-semantic presentation; N+1 text is a PROPOSAL until Compiler N+1 is activated by the Factory
THE CORPUS OF N IS THE COMPATIBILITY ORACLE: Compiler N freezes the expected table of LANGUAGE N; Compiler N+1 reproduces every row or records a migration; the frozen table is never edited
N QUALIFIES N+1: a candidate compiler is never trusted on its own outputs; its bundles are re-verified by the verifier of N and executed; its own test suite is necessary, never sufficient

OBSERVED ASCII IS EVIDENCE: a runtime observation never becomes source without a human/AI reconciliation step; LANGUAGE 1 cannot enforce this (H-14) - until it can, the Factory enforces it by law (no station accepts an observed.ascii as a source unit input)

PRESENTATION FREEDOM IS PRESERVED ACROSS VERSIONS: every presentation-preserving transformation of N stays presentation-preserving in N+1 (the corpus rows of presentation variants keep one canonical rendering)
